meta.title: Pay Your Invoice — Cozelos Data
meta.description: Securely pay your Cozelos Data invoice. We accept card, ACH, and check, with instant receipts and PCI-compliant processing.

hero.title: Pay your invoice securely.
hero.lead: Already a client? Use the secure link from your invoice email, or reach out and we'll send a fresh payment link right away.

payment.title: Make a payment
payment.bodyStripe: Pay securely through our Stripe-protected checkout. Have your invoice number handy so we can match your payment.
payment.bodyRequest: For your security, payment links are generated per invoice. Contact us with your invoice number and we'll send your secure payment link immediately.

items.title: Get your invoice
items.body: We email a detailed invoice with your project reference number and the amount due.

items.title: Pay securely
items.body: Use the secure link in your invoice, or contact us for ACH, card, or check options.

items.title: Instant confirmation
items.body: You receive a receipt immediately, and we get straight back to work.

faqs.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: Major credit and debit cards, ACH bank transfer, and business checks. Recurring maintenance plans can be set to auto-pay.
Yes. Payments are processed through a PCI-compliant, encrypted payment processor. We never see or store your full card details.
Most projects are billed 50% to start and 50% at launch. Maintenance plans are billed monthly. Terms are always confirmed in writing first.

faqs.q: Can I get a receipt or W-9?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Receipts are automatic, and we're happy to provide a W-9 or any documentation your bookkeeping needs.

cta.title: Not a client yet?
cta.body: See what we'd build for your business — and what it would cost.
